sourceCheck.description: fingerprint of the source case before and after; unchanged must be true

Job.title: Mesh Doctor job
Job.description: <workspace>/.jobs/<id>.json, written by jobs.py and jobrun.py; paths are relative to the workspace

id.description: local start time (yyyymmdd-hhmmss), kind, run name and a random suffix

params.description: the parameters the job was asked for

name.description: the workspace run the job writes (an A/B test's label)

runner.description: local, or later slurm / a remote worker

pid.description: the job's wrapper process on the worker

error.description: why it failed, without worker paths

progress.description: added when read: the tool's own status

links.description: added by the API: where to follow the job and its run

Judge.title: Mesh Doctor convergence verdict
Judge.description: output of meshdoctor judge, and fixedJudge inside ab_result.json

to.description: added in 1.1: the run was judged as it was at this iteration or time; later residuals and forces were left out

settled.description: added in 1.2, a transient run only: the time from which its group's drag and vertical force have both settled (MSER-5), where its averages start; null while they haven't, and its averages are then over the last two windows

run.description: added in 1.1, API only: the A/B run judged, <test>_ab/base or <test>_ab/fixed (another test's, when its original-mesh run was reused)

average.description: batch-means averages by name; u is the uncertainty

data.description: base64 of ny rows x nx uint8 wall-face density, top row first
base64 of ny rows x nx uint8 wall-face density, top row first

Repair_checkMesh.description: numbers parsed from checkMesh; absent when checkMesh did not report them

Repair.title: Mesh Doctor repair result
Repair.description: <workspace>/<run>/meshDoctor/result.json, written by meshdoctor full and fix

verdict.description: checkMesh numbers that got better, worse, or stayed the same

collapse.description: the face-collapse stage, or null when it did not run

sourceCheck.description: fingerprint of the source case before and after; unchanged must be true

Report.title: Mesh Doctor report bundle
Report.description: one run's versioned documents in one portable file, written by meshdoctor report; worker paths replaced

name.description: the workspace run

contents.description: per document: its schema version (or legacy), sha256 of its sorted compact JSON, size

Results_force.description: a force over the window, in N; null with fewer than 2 values

sd.description: its standard deviation over the window

drift.description: the change between the means of the window's two halves, over the mean (0.01 = 1 %); null for a mean of 0

u.description: the uncertainty of the mean: the larger of the 95 % interval of 5 batch means and half their spread; null with fewer than 25 values

name.description: its function object's name (its postProcessing folder)

total.description: the total group: the one with the most drag

patches.description: its function object's patches; null where it isn't found in system/

ClA.description: the vertical force over q, in m2, in its own direction (axes.vertical)

LD.description: the vertical force over the drag

Aref.description: the reference area of the forceCoeffs function object that covers its patches; null where none does

Cd.description: drag over that forceCoeffs's own 1/2 rhoInf magUInf^2 Aref

Cl.description: the vertical force over the same, in its own direction (axes.vertical)

Results.title: Mesh Doctor results of a solved case
Results.description: output of meshdoctor results and GET /api/v1/results/{case}, and each item of GET /api/v1/results: each force group's drag and vertical force over an averaging window, how sure they are, its coefficients, how far its residuals fell, and plain warnings

transient.description: a transient run: its times are seconds of flow; else iterations

axes.description: how its forces are read, as the judge reads them (caseinfo.describe)

vertical.description: what its vertical force is: downforce when the total group's points down

source.description: where the flow and up axes came from

Uinf.description: the freestream speed in m/s, from its 0/U; null where it isn't found

rho.description: rhoInf in kg/m3, from its system folder; null where it isn't found

q.description: the dynamic pressure 1/2 rho Uinf^2 in Pa, which CdA and ClA divide by; null without rho or Uinf

cells.description: its mesh's cells, from the owner header (summed over its processors when it is split); null where it doesn't say

updated.description: when its force history was last written (UTC, ISO 8601): a run that solves writes it as it goes (results 1.1)

start.description: the first iteration or time of the total group's force history

end.description: its last, up to the window's to

window.description: the averaging window: the forces after from, up to and with to

from.description: null when there is no force to average

how.description: given: asked for (from); settled: a transient run's, from when its forces settled; judge: the judge's (a steady run's last two judge windows of iterations, a transient run's last two windows of time steps)

n.description: the first group's force values in it

groups.description: each force group with forces in the window: the total group first, then by drag

residuals.description: by field: how far each residual fell up to the window's end

first.description: the largest of its first 10 values

final.description: the median of its last 20 values

orders.description: orders of ten it fell from first to final (log10 first/final); null where one is 0

verdict.description: the judge's verdict on the run up to the window's to (its window: auto)

symmetry.description: its mesh's symmetry patches (symmetryPlane or symmetry); a single one may be the plane of half a model

warnings.description: plain words: a drift over 1 %, a symmetry plane, no q

Tplan.title: Mesh Doctor transient plan
Tplan.description: output of meshdoctor transient-plan: the time step a transient run of a steady case would need, what limits it, and what it would cost

case.description: the case folder's name (not its path)

time.description: the steady result time planned from

decomposed.description: whether it planned from the processors' result (processorN/): the cell set's layout follows it

tool.description: what worked out the Courant numbers: foamCourantCells (Mesh Doctor's own, with the fastest cells' walls, speeds and shapes) or foamPostProcess (OpenFOAM's CourantNo, where foamCourantCells isn't built)

courantPerSecond.description: each cell's Courant number per second of time step, 0.5 sum|phi| / V, in 1/s; withoutTop is the largest once the top fastest cells are left out

top.description: how many of the fastest cells were located

cellsWithin2x.description: cells whose Courant number is within 2x of the largest: the ones that set the time step

regions.description: the fastest cells grouped by place, fastest group first

h.description: median cell size (cube root of volume), m

wall.description: the wall patch most of its cells are nearest (null: no wall on their processor); from foamCourantCells, as are the four below

wallDist.description: its cells' median distance from that wall, m

speed.description: the largest flow speed in its cells, m/s (null: the result has no U)

aspectRatio.description: its cells' largest aspect ratio, as checkMesh's

maxNonOrtho.description: its cells' worst face non-orthogonality, degrees

fastestCells.description: the top fastest cells, fastest first, each [processor, its cell label there] (processor 0 for a case that isn't decomposed): the cell set fastestCells (from foamCourantCells only)

cellSet.description: the cell set of the fastest cells the plan wrote (meshdoctor transient-plan --sets; a tplan job: in <workspace>/.tplans/<case>.sets), in the case's layout: [processorN/]constant/polyMesh/sets/<name>

whole.description: it is on the whole mesh, in constant/polyMesh/sets/<name>: always for a case that isn't split; for a split one, where it has the whole mesh it was split from, each cell found there by its processor's cellProcAddressing (a note says why not). A plan before 1.2 has none: a split case's set was on its processors only

flowTime.description: seconds of flow the costs are for

secondsPerIteration.description: wall seconds per steady iteration, from the solver log

hoursPerFlowSecond.description: wall hours per second of simulated flow

launchToken.description: made fresh at each server start and written into the dashboard pages (<meta name="md-token">), which other sites cannot read
launchToken.name: X-MD-Token

pairingKey.description: the web app's key from `meshdoctor pair` (~/.config/meshdoctor/app.key); accepted only from an address in app_origins, on every /api/v1 request
pairingKey.name: X-MD-Key

info.description: Finds and repairs bad cells in OpenFOAM meshes and tests whether the repair helped the solver.  Served by `meshdoctor serve` on 127.0.0.1 only: requests must name this machine in Host, may not come from another site's page (Origin), and POST requests need the launch token from the dashboard page.  The Mesh Doctor web app (an address in app_origins) sends the pairing key instead, on every request.

oneOf.description: plan a transient run of a solved case: from its latest result, the time step its mesh allows at each Courant number, which cells set it, and the steps and hours such a run would take. The case is only read: OpenFOAM works in a throwaway shadow case of links to it, and the cell set of the fastest cells goes in the workspace, beside the plan

name.description: a case in the cases folder with a solved result: a run (GET /runs), or a case you made (GET /cases)

oneOf.description: make pictures of a solved case's flow with ParaView, offscreen, at a written time, or of a transient run's mean flow: cuts from its cut list (cuts.json) or made from its model's size, its vortices, and any spot of unphysical pressure on its walls (Cp below -5: a numerical error). The case is only read: ParaView reads it through a folder of links, and the pictures go in the workspace, with a list of them; a computer's first set starts with ParaView's self test (API 1.15; the mean flow and the self test, API 1.16). The one exception: a time of a run Mesh Doctor made that is still split onto its processes is joined first, into the run's own folder, as its solve joins the latest of each stretch (API 1.19). Asked for, a cut over time: the first cut's speed at each written time up to the one pictured, read as they are kept; and a mean flow's cuts show how much the speed swings about it (API 1.20). Asked for, the cells that set the time step: the 100 with the highest Courant number at that time, as a transient plan finds them, written alone by foamToVTK through links in the set's folder and drawn with the walls, from three sides and each of the three fastest places close up; not of a mean flow (API 1.21)

kinds.description: what to make, comma-separated: cuts, vortices, spots, times (a cut over time: the first cut's speed at each written time up to the one pictured, at most 50 evenly picked, each read as it is kept, joined or split, none joined for it: API 1.20) and fastest (the cells that set the time step, with the walls; not with mean: API 1.21)

mean.description: a transient run's mean flow (UMean and pMean) in place of the flow at that time: a time written once its averaging is on (GET /runs' averaging); its set is <time>_mean (API 1.16)

name.description: a case in the cases folder with a written result: a run (GET /runs), or a case you made (GET /cases)

time.description: the written time to picture, as its folder says it (default: the latest; with mean, the latest with a mean flow). One still split onto the case's processes (GET /runs' times, not joined) is joined first, into the run's own folder, when Mesh Doctor made the run; a case you made is read as it is, split (API 1.19)

averaging.description: a transient run's averaged flow (the fieldAverage meanFlow: UMean, pMean, UPrime2Mean and pPrime2Mean in each time it writes), which the solve switches on once its forces have settled, as the transient judge finds that; all null until then; null for a steady run, or a transient run with none (made before API 1.9 and not solved since, as its next solve gives it one; or with a fieldAverage of its own) (API 1.9)

from.description: the time it averages from, in s: the latest time written with it less its averaging's totalTime, else the time the solver was at when it was switched on

settled.description: when its forces had settled then, in s

written.description: the latest time written with it, in s; null before one

end.description: the iteration the latest stretch runs to (endTime)

error.description: why it failed (state failed), naming no folders

finished.description: when the latest stretch ended (UTC); null while it runs

iteration.description: the last iteration in its solver log (a transient run's: the time in s, as are its other times)

joined.description: those of its times that are joined, the whole mesh's, in the case's own folder: every one when it isn't split, else the latest of each stretch (API 1.10), and any other a picture job has joined to picture it (API 1.19)

links.description: itself, Stop, and its convergence judge (GET /judge?case=; a transient run's with window=auto, over the last half of its time steps as its page judges it, API 1.11)

nProcs.description: the processes it runs on; 1: the case isn't split

name.description: the case it solves: a case in the cases folder that Mesh Doctor made

start.description: the iteration the latest stretch started from

state.description: stopped: ended at a written iteration before its end (Stop); interrupted: its status says running but nothing solves it: no job, and no solve in a terminal (the computer restarted, or the job or the solve was killed)

step.description: copying (a copy of a case you made), meshing or meshing: <its mesh's step> (a case made from a template first), decomposing, potentialFoam, solving, reconstructing or done

stretches.description: the stretches solved so far, oldest first

times.description: the written times it keeps, oldest first, not its start: its processors' and its own when it is split (a transient run keeps every one; a steady run as many as its controlDict's purgeWrite says) (API 1.10)

transient.description: a transient run: the steady run it started from, and the time of that run's result it took (at), its largest Courant number and its model; null for a steady run (API 1.6)

writes.description: the times each of its stretches writes, evenly to its end: it keeps every one (4 for a run that never asked) (API 1.10)

written.description: the latest iteration written, which a continuation starts from

default.description: Error (the code says which; see STATUS in api_v1.py)

post.summary: Stop a run at a written iteration: it writes the iteration it is at and ends, so a later solve job continues from there.  Needs the token or pairing key (API 1.6)

schema.description: plain folder name: letters, digits, _ . - (no leading dot), at most 80 characters

cd.description: its drag coefficient: the window's mean

cl.description: its lift coefficient: the window's mean

comparable.description: solved to the accuracy check's iterations or more

drift.description: percent: the drag of the window's second half against its first; near 0 once it has settled

iterations.description: the last iteration with force coefficients

matches.description: comparable, and its drag within 2 % of the accuracy check's: the install gives the same answer

name.description: the run: a case made from the Ahmed body template

published.description: the accuracy check's run of the same mesh (docs/validation.md)

difference.description: percent: this run's drag against it

size.description: its mesh: the accuracy check has a run of each

slant.description: the body's rear slant, in degrees

state.description: stopped: ended at a written iteration before its end (Stop); interrupted: its status says running but nothing solves it: no job, and no solve in a terminal (the computer restarted, or the job or the solve was killed)

template.description: the template it was made from (ahmed-body)

cd.description: the wind tunnel's drag coefficient (Ahmed, Ramm & Faltin 1984)

difference.description: percent: this run's drag against it

window.description: the iterations its drag and lift are averaged over: the last quarter, as the accuracy check takes them

default.description: Error (the code says which; see STATUS in api_v1.py)

get.summary: Verify install: how a run of the Ahmed body template compares with the wind tunnel and with the accuracy check's run of the same mesh (docs/validation.md), its drag and lift taken over the last quarter of its iterations (API 1.6)

default.description: Error (the code says which; see STATUS in api_v1.py)

get.summary: JSON Schema of a versioned result document (repair, abtest, judge, map)

about.description: what the case is, in a sentence or two

name.description: the template's folder in examples/, as a case job names it

size.description: the size a case job makes when it names none

cells.description: about how many cells the mesh has, as OpenFOAM 14 made it here

default.description: Error (the code says which; see STATUS in api_v1.py)
